profile.title: Astaantaada
profile.subtitle: Macluumaadkan waxaa la wadaagaa jaamacadaha iyo ururrada marka lagama maarmaan yahay.
profile.createHint: Weli ma lihid astaan — buuxi macluumaadka hoose si aad u samayso mid.

errors.generic: Wax baa qaldamay. Fadlan isku day mar kale.

profile.enrollmentHint: Jaamacaddaadu way xaqiijisaa diiwaannadan, sidaa darteed waxaa lagu maamulaa bogga diiwaangelinta.

enrollment.title: Diiwaangelinta jaamacadda

status.NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE: Waxaa loo baahan yahay caddayn dheeraad ah

enrollment.needsMoreEvidenceTitle: Jaamacaddaadu waxay u baahan tahay caddayn dheeraad ah
enrollment.pendingReviewBody: Jaamacaddaadu waxay dib u eegaysaa diiwaangelintaada. Waa lagu wargelin doonaa marka dib-u-eegistu dhammaato ama haddii caddayn dheeraad ah loo baahdo.
enrollment.challengeBody: Samee koodh mar-hal-ah oo tus shaqaalaha jaamacadda marka ay si toos ah kuu xaqiijinayaan.
enrollment.claimSubtitle: Noo sheeg jaamacadda iyo qaybta aad ku qoran tahay.

errors.STUDENT_NUMBER_ALREADY_REGISTERED: Lambarkan ardayga horeba ayaa jaamacaddan lagu diiwaan geliyay.
errors.DEPARTMENT_NOT_IN_UNIVERSITY: Qaybtan kama tirsana jaamacadda la doortay.
errors.STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_LOCKED: Diiwaangelintan lama beddeli karo intii xaalad xaqiijin socoto jirto.
errors.VERIFICATION_CASE_ALREADY_RESOLVED: Xaaladdan xaqiijinta horeba waa la xalliyay.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Fadlan hubi faahfaahinta oo isku day mar kale.
errors.generic: Hadda lama kaydin karin. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale.
errors.STUDENT_ID_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Soo geli aqoonsi arday oo sax ah ka hor intaadan xaqiijinta gudbin.

verified.title: Jaamacaddaadu waxay xaqiijisay diiwaangelintaada
verified.body: Hadda waad codsan kartaa tabobaro, waxaana ku magacaabi kara waaxdaada. Tani waxay xaqiijinaysaa diiwaangelintaada oo keliya — waa ka duwan tahay akoonkaaga iyo xaqiijinta machadka.

steps.review: Jaamacaddaadu way dib u eegtay sheegashada.

verified.nextBody: Codsiyadu waa kuu furan yihiin. Bogga oo dhammaystiran ayaa ah waxa ugu horreeya ee hay,adaha ay akhriyaan.

enrollment.studentNumberHint: Lambarka ardayga ee jaamacaddaadu ku siisay. Shaqaalaha jaamacaddu waxay ku hubiyaan diiwaannadooda.
enrollment.whyBody: Ardayda ay xaqiijisay jaamacaddoodu oo keliya ayaa codsan kara tababaro ama la magacaabi karaa. Shaqaalaha jaamacaddaadu waxay faahfaahintan la barbar dhigaan diiwaankooda.

statusMeaning.DRAFT: Faahfaahintaada waa la keydiyay laakiin weli looma dirin jaamacaddaada. Soo geli kaarka ardaygaaga, kadib gudbi.
statusMeaning.NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE: Jaamacaddaadu waxay u baahan tahay caddayn dheeraad ah ka hor inta aysan go’aan gaarin. Akhri qoraalka hoose, soo geli dukumeenti cad ama ka duwan, kadib dib u gudbi.
statusMeaning.REJECTED: Jaamacaddaadu ma xaqiijin karin diiwaangelintan. La xiriir xafiiska tababarka jaamacaddaada haddii aad u malaynayso inay khalad tahay.
statusMeaning.REVOKED: Jaamacaddaadu way kala noqotay xaqiijintan. La xiriir xafiiska tababarka jaamacaddaada si loo xalliyo.

enrollment.whileWaiting: Inta aad sugeyso, waad dhammaystiri kartaa astaantaada oo daalacan kartaa tababarada. Codsashadu waxay furantaa marka diiwaangelintaada la xaqiijiyo.

cv.title: CV-gaaga
cv.description: PDF oo keliya, ilaa 5 MB. Adiga iyo qorayaasha shaqada ee hay'adaha aad codsatay ama lagugu magacaabay oo keliya ayaa furi kara.

errors.generic: CV-gaaga lama keydin karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
errors.CV_FILE_INVALID: Faylkaas lama aqbalin. Soo geli PDF.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: Faylkaas aad buu u weyn yahay. Xadka ugu badan waa 5 MB.
errors.APPLICATION_CV_REQUIRED: Soo geli CV PDF ah oo codsigan loogu talagalay.
errors.APPLICATION_CV_NOT_FOUND: CV-gan looma heli karo codsigan. Mar kale soo geli.
errors.APPLICATION_CV_ALREADY_USED: CV-gan wuxuu hore ugu xiran yahay codsi la gudbiyey.
errors.STUDENT_ACTION_REQUIRED: Codsiyada iyo tababarada la kaydiyey waxaa heli kara akoonnada Ardayga.
errors.FILE_NOT_FOUND: Dukumentigan hadda lama heli karo. Mar kale soo geli.

evidence.title: Caddaynta xaqiijinta
evidence.description: PDF ama sawir kaadhkaaga ardayga ama warqadda diiwaangelinta, ilaa 10 MB. Adiga, dib-u-eegayaasha jaamacaddaada iyo shaqaalaha xaqiijinta FursadHub oo keliya ayaa furi kara.

errors.generic: Caddayntaada lama keydin karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
errors.EVIDENCE_FILE_INVALID: Faylkaas lama aqbalin. Soo geli PDF, JPEG ama PNG.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: Faylkaas aad buu u weyn yahay. Xadka ugu badan waa 10 MB.
errors.VERIFICATION_CASE_NOT_FOUND: Marka hore u gudbi diiwaangelintaada xaqiijin.
errors.STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_LOCKED: Caddaynta waxaa la beddeli karaa ka hor gudbinta ama marka dib-u-eeguhu codsado caddayn dheeraad ah.
errors.ENROLLMENT_NOT_FOUND: Kaydi faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta ka hor soo gelinta aqoonsiga ardayga.

saved.title: Tababarrada la keydiyay
saved.subtitle: Tababarrada aad calaamadisay markii aad baadhaysay. Waxaa halkan ka muuqda oo keliya tababarrada weli codsi u furan.
saved.emptyHint: Isticmaal calaamadda keydinta ee tababar kasta si aad halkan ugu hayso.
saved.error: Ma soo bandhigi karno tababarradaada la keydiyay.
saved.emptyNeedsProfile: Keydinta tababar wuxuu u baahan yahay astaantaada arday. Hal mar geli faahfaahintaada, kadibna waxaa halkan lagu hayn doonaa keydkaaga.

placementActive.title: Tababarkaagu waa socdaa
placementActive.body: Cusbooneysii diiwaannadaada, xaadirintaada iyo warbixintaada — wax kasta oo tababarkan ku saabsan hal meel ayay ku yaallaan.

placementPlanned.title: Tababarkaaga waa la xaqiijiyay
placementPlanned.body: Wuxuu bilaabanayaa {{date}}. Hay'adda martigelisay ayaa ka bilaabaysa FursadHub maalintaada ugu horraysa.

completionPending.title: Tababarkaaga waxaa loo eegayaa dhammaystirka
completionPending.body: Jaamacaddaadu waxay hubinaysaa shuruudaha dhammaystirka. Waa lagu wargelin doonaa marka uu dhammaado.

offerWaiting.title: Dalab tababar ayaa ku sugaya
offerWaiting.body: Eeg dalabka oo ka jawaab ka hor {{date}}. Adiga oo keliya ayaa aqbali kara ama diidi kara.

nominationWaiting.title: Jaamacaddaadu way ku magacaabtay
nominationWaiting.body: Hay'addu ma arkayso magacaabistaada ilaa aad oggolaato in lagu tixgeliyo.

enrollmentMissing.title: Ku bilow inaad sheegato diiwaangelintaada jaamacadeed
enrollmentMissing.body: Jaamacaddaadu waxay xaqiijisaa inaad ardaygeeda tahay. Ilaa markaas waad daalacan kartaa, laakiin ma codsan kartid lamana magacaabi karo.

enrollmentIncomplete.title: Dhammaystir diiwaangelintaada
enrollmentIncomplete.body: Ku dar kaarka ardayga oo gudbi si jaamacaddaadu u xaqiijiso diiwaangelintaada.

enrollmentChangesRequested.title: Jaamacaddaadu waxay codsatay caddayn dheeraad ah
enrollmentChangesRequested.body: Akhri qoraalkooda, cusbooneysii kaarka ardayga, oo mar kale gudbi.

enrollmentInReview.title: Jaamacaddaadu waxay eegaysaa diiwaangelintaada
enrollmentInReview.body: Hadda waxba lagaama rabo. Inta aad sugayso waad daalacan kartaa tababarrada; codsigu wuxuu furmayaa marka lagu xaqiijiyo.

enrollmentClosed.title: Diiwaangelintaada lama xaqiijin
enrollmentClosed.body: Jaamacaddaadu ma xaqiijin diiwaangelintaada. Akhri qoraalkooda bogga diiwaangelinta.

applicationsInProgress.title: Codsiyadaadu waa socdaan
applicationsInProgress.body: Hay'aduhu waa eegayaan. Waa lagu wargelin doonaa marka wax isbeddelaan.

completed.title: Waad dhammaysay tababarkaaga
completed.body: Hambalyo. Diiwaanka tababarkaagu halkan ayuu ku sii jirayaa.

readyToApply.title: Waad diyaar u tahay inaad codsato
readyToApply.body: Diiwaangelintaada waa la xaqiijiyay. Hel tababar kugu habboon oo codso.

attention.title: Waxa u baahan feejignaantaada
attention.clearBody: Wax walba waa la cusbooneysiiyay. Codsiyada cusub ee jaamacaddaada ama hay'adaha halkan ayay ka muuqan doonaan.
